To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the SA can not be applied in the same way in the CDMA and the TD-SCDMA system, because of the difference between the two systems, the SA can not simultaneously realize multiple CD MA channels directional transmission on the same frequency with the same SNR gain.
the SA can only realize the directional transmission of a CDMA channel in the downlink, but can't realize the directional transmission in the uplink.

the reciprocity characteristic of SA in CDCA system is not as people think, and the SA direction-transmitting principle in CDMA is different from the SA receiving principle, the SA direction-transmitter can only realize the uplink beamforming by amplitude-weight transmitting, and the downlink beamforming can only be realized by carrier frequency weight method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of SA for CDMA system, and it is of great significance to the development of 3G system.
the application of smart antennas in the CDMA systems and the reciprocity characteristic of smart antennas in CDMA system.
how to take full use of SA to improve the capacity and the quality of service in the CDMA systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SA is not suitable for the CDMA system.

the smart antennas can be applied to CDMA system, but the SA direction-transmitting principle in CDMA is different from the SA receiving principle, and we can only realize the uplink and downlink SNR gains by using SA.

SA in CDMA systems can be used in the following two aspects: 1) SA can be used in a single CDMA channel to improve the SNR gain of the uplink & down-link; 2) SA can be applied to the multiple CDMA channels, and the carrier frequency can be reused.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SA can be applied in the CDMA systems.
we should not consider the CDMA system and the SA as two separate systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SA in the CDMA systems is not as easy as people think.
SA can be applied in CDMA system to improve the system capacity and the performance of the system.
the reciprocity characteristic of SA in CDMS system is different from that in TDMA system, and the carrier weight method we proposed is feasible and effective.
